data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 28/2040Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA FORECAST TO BE A SHORT LIVED TROPICAL STORM AS IT MOVES EASTWARD ACROSS THE CENTRAL SUBTROPICAL ATLANTIC. As of 5:00 PM AST Mon Sep 28 the center of Hanna was located near 36.5, -48.7 with movement ESE at 17 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 28/2347Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL SLIGHTLY STRONGER. As of 6:00 PM CST Mon Sep 28 the center of Rachel was located near 14.3, -102.5 with movement WNW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 997 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 60 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Fay (AT1), advisory 29/0236Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY REACHES TROPICAL STORM STRENGTH AGAIN. As of 11:00 PM AST Mon Sep 28 the center of Fay was located near 26.0, -45.9 with movement SW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 29/0234Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO ABOUT TO MAKE LANDFALL IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR. ...LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODING ONGOING... As of 8:00 PM MST Mon Sep 28 the center of Polo was located near 25.9, -112.5 with movement NE at 13 mph. The minimum central pressure was 963 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 115 mph.
